description: JA4proxy telemetry enrichment pipeline. Parses ECS JSON, enriches source.ip with GeoIP and ASN data, and normalises field types for Kibana Security.

json.description: Parse the raw ECS JSON message if it arrives as a string. Skip if already parsed.

script.description: Promote top-level _parsed fields into the document if JSON parsing succeeded.
script.source: if (ctx._parsed != null) { for (entry in ctx._parsed.entrySet()) { ctx[entry.getKey()] = entry.getValue(); } ctx.remove('_parsed'); }

geoip.description: Enrich source IP with city-level GeoIP data. Populates source.geo.* fields. Uses the bundled MaxMind GeoLite2-City database.
Enrich source IP with ASN data. Populates source.as.* fields. Requires the GeoLite2-ASN Elasticsearch ingest database plugin.

convert.description: Ensure source.port is integer type for range queries.
Ensure event.risk_score is float for range aggregations.

set.description: Set service.name if not already present (should always be 'ja4proxy').

date.description: Parse @timestamp from ISO-8601 string to Elasticsearch date. Needed if the upstream shipper sends it as a string.

fingerprint.description: Generate a document ID fingerprint from the event's unique attributes. Prevents duplicate documents when Vector retries delivery.

set.description: Tag the event with the pipeline version for troubleshooting.
Tag failed events for review without dropping them.
